title: Title: "Mastering Large Language Model Evaluation"
description: Here we discusses the importance of evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) in natural language processing, highlighting technical metrics like Perplexity, BLEU Score, and ROUGE Score. It also mentions libraries for evaluation such as Hugging Face Transformers and TensorFlow Text, and higher-level evaluation methods based on factors like effort saved, number of interactions, and user satisfaction.
